id.description: Must equal the pack's folder name.

name.description: Process name shown in the app.

sources.description: Source documents. Local files (path) are ingested; third-party documents are linked (url), never bundled.

path.description: File inside the pack (.md, .html, .txt, .pdf you have rights to).

sample_input.description: Example case: inline object or a .json file path.

test_cases.description: JSONL file: test_name, description, input_data, expected_assertions, mock_llm_judge.

summary.description: Required keys of the engine result's summary, mapped to descriptions.

agent_guidance.description: Domain hints for the agents: inline text or a .md file path.

reference_code.description: Folder containing an engine/ package with engine/engine.py:run_engine(case).

sample_outputs.description: Optional pre-generated outputs so people can explore without an LLM API key.
